list: The official 55 trophies, frozen 2026-11-18: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze.
note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18 (the two agree on every name, description and grade). Guides are this entry's own words, written from the official descriptions and the counts PlayStation tracks; exact in-game locations and steps are NOT yet verified in play, and the guide says so wherever a step is not pinned down. Missable flags are judged from the official descriptions alone — treat them as 'do it when the chance comes' until the community confirms them. Never copy another guide's text: sources are cited, never copied.

sources.official_list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies): official names, descriptions and grades.
sources.counts: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi): the counts PlayStation tracks for each trophy.
sources.guides: This guide's own advice, written from the official descriptions above. No other guide's text is used.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the roadmap in order (story, then side missions, then activities, then collectibles and cleanup) and it will come last. Expect a long hunt: the 100% completion trophy and the big count trophies are the real grind.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver grind: pull off 250 stunts in total. Stunts are the game's jump, flip and airtime moments — use ramps, jumps and fast cars, and let the counter build up naturally across the whole playthrough instead of farming it in one sitting. Check the in-game stats to see your running total.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 250).

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sampler trophy: try all 9 activity types at least once — races, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the other open-world activities. Early on, dip into each new activity the first time you see it rather than saving them all for the end; one try each is enough.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 9 types).

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver skill trophy: earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is a test of aim, not firepower — learn each challenge's target pattern, use the weapon it asks for, and replay a challenge until the gold score lands. Do a few per session so it never feels like a wall.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 42).

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone racing is about the racing line, not speed alone — learn each course's gates on a practice run, then race to win. Work through the locations as you explore the map so the last few are not a long drive away.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 14).

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same one 20 times. Try a mix of street races and other race types as you meet them, keep a mental note of which events you have already won, and pick a fast, stable car for each event type.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 20).

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are timing and patience — watch the line tension, reel in steady bursts, and do not rush the catch. If you lose, challenge Cal again; it is repeatable until you win.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game from start to end. Pick the shortest or easiest cabinet you find, learn its controls in the first minute, and play it through — completion, not a high score, is what counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Side-mission chain: finish Andy's mission strand through to its final mission. Side contacts give their missions over time, so answer Andy's calls and visit his marker whenever it appears — do his strand as it opens rather than leaving it all for after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Side-mission chain: finish Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Keep Kenton's strand moving whenever his missions unlock, and the trophy pops at the end of his last one.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Side-mission chain: finish Billy's mission strand through to its final mission. Billy's strand is bike-flavoured — expect riding missions — and the trophy lands when his story is done.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver: complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as markers on the map as you explore — stop for them, follow each one's short chain to its end, and keep a count of finished strands. Exploring every region of the map is the way to find them all.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 8).

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Side-mission chain: finish Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Take Randy's jobs as they come up during the story and the finale of his strand unlocks in turn.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Side-mission chain: finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission. Work through Tyrone's jobs whenever they appear and his final mission — and this trophy — will follow.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic points on the map — visit one, meditate, and move on. Fold them into your exploration route so you tick them off region by region instead of hunting 18 dots at the end.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 18).

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It unlocks early, so just play the story and it pops on its own — no special preparation needed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: play through every mission in Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies pop as the story advances, so keep following the main missions and do not worry about skipping side content yet.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish every mission in Chapter 2. As with the other chapter trophies, it pops automatically when the chapter's story is done — the name is printed here exactly as PlayStation publishes it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete Chapter 3 in full. Keep pushing the main story missions; side activities can wait for the post-story cleanup stages of the roadmap.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so once it pops you are one final mission away from the story's gold trophy.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold, unmissable: finish the final story mission and the credits roll with this trophy. Before you start it, clear any one-shot chances you care about (see the Missables page) — after the finale you may not be able to go back to them.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Mission trophies pop as you play the main missions in order — no extra objectives required.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete The Cartel Heist mission. Heist missions are story beats, so follow the mission markers when the story sends you there and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the mission Child's Play. Like every named-mission trophy, it is earned by finishing that mission in the story — nothing optional is needed for it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the mission Headliners. Play the story in order and it unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the mission VCIA Takedown. The name hints at the airport — expect a vehicle takedown at Vice City International — but the trophy itself only needs the mission finished.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the mission and the trophy pops; the operation's exact steps are part of the story, so follow the on-screen objectives.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold, and the real endgame: reach 100% in the game's completion checklist. That checklist covers the story, side missions, activities, collectibles and counts across this whole guide — so this trophy is really the sum of everything else. Save it for last, use the in-game stats screen to find what is still missing, and treat the roadmap's cleanup stage as its checklist.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. This is a hunting job for a stranger — find the animal Bret wants, track it, and take the shot. Unique animals are one-of-a-kind hunts, so approach quietly and make the first shot count.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver collectible: complete 3 full sets of collectible cards. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, houses and out-of-the-way spots — so pick them up whenever you pass one and track which sets are still missing cards. Three complete sets is the target, not every card in the game.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 3).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver grind: use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. WAiNK It is the game's check-in-style activity at marked spots — visit a spot, trigger it, and move on. Fold it into exploration: whenever you enter a new area, look for its WAiNK spot before leaving.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 100).

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges are the small optional goals scattered through activities and the open world — they stack up on their own while you play, but check the challenges list now and then and clear the easy ones to keep the count climbing.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 50).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do it when the chance comes: with your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape together. Plan it: get the wanted level somewhere with open roads and hiding spots, break line of sight, and stay hidden until the stars clear. If the moment passes, a later chance may not come — treat this as missable until the community confirms otherwise.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do it when the chance comes: with your partner, rob 3 shops one after another without losing your wanted level between them. Pick three shops close together on a quiet stretch, keep the wanted level alive (do not escape or get busted between robberies), and move fast from one to the next. Plan the route before the first robbery.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 3).

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Every new car, bike, boat or aircraft you get into counts the first time — so drive everything you see, especially the rare and unusual ones. The counter grows naturally with exploration; check the vehicle list to see what is still undiscovered.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 100).

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a group of enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and work through them fast while it lasts. If you only get three or four, reload the moment and try again — it is repeatable.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 5).

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do it when the chance comes: make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — leave by a route that is not a scheduled flight. The description points at the airport itself, so try the runways or an aircraft on the tarmac. Treat it as a one-shot chance until confirmed repeatable.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos — the game's tanks — and survive the heat. Expect heavy armour and a big gun: keep your distance, use explosives or heavy weapons, and use cover between shots. The trophy's wording suggests just getting through a Rhino encounter is the point.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do it when the chance comes: rob a jewelry store clean without ever being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses spotting you, no cameras catching you — and get out before anyone raises the alarm. Save first if you can, so a blown attempt costs you nothing.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver: rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the bigger heist-style robberies — plan the entry, grab the cash, and have an escape route ready before the alarm brings the heat. Five successful escapes is the whole job.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 5).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol the roads — stop one, get the crew out or the doors open, take the cash, then lose the wanted level. Any successful truck robbery and escape earns it.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel — drive, fly and sail into every named area until the counter hits 52. The far corners and islands are the ones players miss, so use the map's area list to find the gaps at the end.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 52).

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs its own operations around the state — hit one operation per gang and keep a checklist of which gangs you have done. Gang territory markers on the map are your guide to finding them.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 9).

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a sea view, order a cocktail, and enjoy it — a quiet moment trophy, no challenge involved. It is a nice one to do early, while you are first exploring Vice City.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do it when the chance comes: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the front. Pick a showroom, get a car inside or lined up at the door, and go. Treat it as a one-shot stunt until the community confirms it can be repeated.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Find the alley, play a game of bowling, and follow through on your throws — the trophy is about playing the game there, not a perfect score. A relaxed activity trophy to tick off during exploration.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do it when the chance comes: a partnership moment with mass appeal — the description is deliberately vague, and the exact trigger is not pinned down from the official description alone. Watch for a partner-activity moment that draws a crowd, and do it while the chance is in front of you. Treat as missable until confirmed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: MISSABLE in the small choices: make choices — PlayStation tracks a count to 500. The game is full of little decisions, dialogue picks and moral forks; keep choosing rather than avoiding them, and the count climbs across the whole playthrough. Some choices only appear once, so pick a side when one is offered instead of walking away.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks a count to 500).

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do it when the chance comes: succeed on a second try — the description suggests a moment where the first attempt fails and the retry lands. When something goes wrong in a mission or activity, do not reload an old save: try again right away and the second success may be the trigger.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — a weird event somewhere in Leonida. Strange encounters hide in the open world, often at odd hours or in remote places. Explore at night, poke around unusual landmarks, and when something bizarre happens, this trophy pops. The exact event is not pinned down from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do it when the chance comes: knock someone over with a melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl your target over. Line up a slow pass past a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and keep moving. It is a stunt-style trophy, so try it whenever a clear chance appears.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists and cannot be spent directly — take them to your laundering contacts, who clean a cut for you. Keep laundering after every big score and the total will reach $250,000 well before the end.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks $250,000).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every shop purchase counts — weapons, clothes, cars, food — so just buy what you need as you play and the total adds up. Late in the game, if you are short, an expensive car or weapon is the fastest way to close the gap.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks $100,000).

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are for sale around Leonida — each one gives you storage and a place to keep your collection. They cost real money, so buy them as your funds allow, and check property listings whenever you are in a new area.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 8).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you find a vehicle worth keeping, register it in the app instead of just driving it away — ten registrations is all it takes. Do it as you discover new vehicles so the count grows alongside Whip It Good.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (PSN tracks 10).
